notes.title: Rebalance, Real time, Steam Watch
notes.content:
Hi all!

Now Watch displays real time:

Watches with rarity S and LUX show real time. Only in 3D mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102220/3dbbccf1d490c7de5733ab6cec4fba29a47dfb4f.png[/img]

Rebalance:

Increased the speed bonus from owning a Watch.

Tier 5 [+10] → [+15]
Tier 4 [+20] → [+25]
Tier 3 [+30] → [+50]
Tier 2 [+40] → [+100]
Tier 1 [+50] → [+250]
Tier S [+75] → [+500]
Tier LUX [+100] → [+1000]

Shop:

Added collectible [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/894060/]Watches with the Steam logo[/url], as a small bonus they multiply your overall speed by 2. If you have several Steam Watches, then their multiplier is added together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102220/818053925f3c14dca26df5b73340992d858c63be.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102220/3f123ccdffc6553b2f53e7abb999b44ac7e48103.png[/img]
